scripts.test: npm run test:application && npm run test:e2e && npm run check:powershell && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:vulnerabilities
scripts.test:application: npm run check:server && npm run lint:server && npm run test:server && npm run test:atlas-performance
scripts.check:vulnerabilities: trivy fs --scanners vuln --include-dev-deps --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs artifacts .
scripts.test:atlas-performance: npm run build:server && node --import tsx server/tools/benchmark-atlas.ts
scripts.cloudflare:check: npm run cloudflare:types && tsc -p cloudflare/tsconfig.json --noEmit && wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --env preview --dry-run --outdir artifacts/cloudflare-preview
